title: Red Hat, NVIDIA, IBM back project turning AI policy into code
summary: Red Hat has launched asago, an open-source community project backed by NVIDIA and IBM that automates the conversion of AI governance policies into production-ready deployment code. The project provides an auditable workflow designed to bridge the gap between compliance teams and engineering teams, addressing the growing complexity of AI regulation compliance.
problem_solved: Closes the gap between AI policy/regulation requirements and actual production deployment by automating the translation of governance rules into executable code.
why_valuable: Enables organizations to efficiently comply with emerging AI regulations like the EU AI Act by providing standardized, auditable workflows that connect fragmented compliance and engineering processes.
